decisions.reason: The candidate already records the category label's placement with the article title and its visually appealing presentation from the same message; the source modification only adds the author attribution's placement after that title and category label.
Placement of author attribution does not change the requirement to improve article image quality when necessary.
The author attribution placement decision does not change where articles must be sourced.
The source decision does not alter the policy reserving red for the cover and excluding it from the Elon Musk article.
Author attribution placement does not change the deferred print-ready output format, resolution, or trim-and-bleed requirements.
A visually appealing article metadata arrangement is compatible with, but does not modify, the existing polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The placement of author attribution within article pages does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The source specifies a local article-metadata arrangement but does not change the candidate's general template, supplied-input, compilation, or Flat Plan arrangement requirements.
